sloka: इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया ।मामैक्षत ततः क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव ।। ५.५८.१४३ ।।।।
transliteration: iti vānararājastvāmāhetyabhihito mayā ।māmaikṣata tataḥ kruddhaścakṣuṣā pradahanniva ।। 5.58.143 ।।।।

translations.english: 'This I was asked to tell you by the king of vanaras wishing your welfare'. 'Ravana then angrily looked at me as if to burn me.
